summary.intent: Fix apps/validate's RDT oracle crash against typescript^7 (steps 1-3 of the type-checker-integration.md 'Next step' plan: TS6 API for RDT, build a tsc-api semantic probe, re-run parity against the full fixture corpus), then investigate and clean up a large pile of unrelated pending doc/config changes found sitting uncommitted in the working tree.
summary.outcome: RDT oracle fixed via an aliased typescript-next dependency (RDT stays on typescript@6.0.3, semantic probe uses typescript@next), a new run-semantic.ts/parity.ts pipeline was built and verified against the full 44-file/47-component corpus with results documented in docs/type-checker-integration.md, and three commits landed: the oracle fix, an AGENTS.md/ADR/prose cleanup pass, and a .claude/semantic-model → docs/architecture/ relocation, all done via four parallel subagents plus manual follow-up fixes.

repo: apps/validate has no output abstraction (unlike crates/cli's AGENTS.md rule); console.log/console.error is the established convention across baseline.ts, compare.ts, analyze.ts, run-react-docgen-typescript.ts despite chalk being a listed dependency

pnpm-workspace 'overrides' entries get recorded in pnpm-lock.yaml but don't actually rewrite peer dependency resolution in practice; use a package.json aliased dependency (e.g. typescript-next: npm:typescript@next) instead to pin a specific subdependency's resolution
typescript@next ships a full async Checker/Program API under typescript/unstable/async (class-based, not raw JSON-RPC) with SyntaxKind separately exported from typescript/unstable/ast
RDT (react-docgen-typescript) has a real bug: multiple forwardRef components in one file cross-contaminate element types between components (found in fixtures/rdt-compat/svg-icon.tsx)

docs/adr/README.md contains the house style rules (banned words like leverage/utilize/robust, sentence-case headers, active voice, no filler) that should apply repo-wide to all .md docs, not just ADRs
docs/archive/README.md convention: archived docs' internal content/paths are never rewritten to look historically accurate; only the archive index entry gets updated with a 'superseded by X' note

repo convention: .claude/, .codex/, .gemini/, .agents/ are per-tool config dirs invisible to other agents — cross-tool-relevant docs (like the semantic model) must live under docs/ instead, matching callisto's prior 'move semantic model out of .claude' precedent

code.finding: Reimplements RDT's extraction algorithm via typescript@next's tsc-api async client; was refactored from an await-in-loop shape to Promise.all-based parallelism to satisfy oxlint's no-await-in-loop/no-nested-ternary rules, verified byte-identical output (modulo Symbol.iterator id noise) before/after refactor
New script diffing run-semantic.ts output against the committed RDT baseline; added chalk-colored summary output

'Template literal type → opaque' row was stale; current snapshot (crates/core/tests/snapshots/snapshots__snapshot_mantine.snap) shows mantine's size MantineSize | `compact-${MantineSize}` now fully resolves to a proper literal union, so the row was corrected from ❌ to ✅

workflow: When several teammate subagents edit overlapping files concurrently (e.g. AGENTS.md touched by both docs-cleanup-root and docs-cleanup-semantic-model), their edits can apply cleanly without conflict if scoped to different lines — worth spot-checking afterward rather than assuming collision

Used the 'entire' search/checkpoint CLI to trace the provenance of a large uncommitted working-tree change pile back to a specific prior session's checkpoints and exact prompts, rather than guessing from git diff alone

Split unrelated concurrent work into separate commits even when found in the same working tree at the same time: oracle-fix (steps1-3) landed as its own commit, separate from the AGENTS.md/ADR/prose cleanup and the semantic-model relocation, because they were causally and thematically independent
For teammate (SendMessage/subagent) idle_notification messages that duplicate an already-reported summary, acknowledge briefly rather than re-summarizing

friction: pnpm-workspace overrides silently failed to rewrite RDT's typescript peer resolution despite being recorded in the lockfile, requiring several install/verify/rm -rf node_modules cycles before switching to the aliased-dependency approach
Reading typescript@next's unstable async API required manually greping/reading compiled dist/api/async/api.js since there's no public documentation for the new tsc-api surface

A large, seemingly unrelated pile of uncommitted changes (CLAUDE.md→AGENTS.md renames, .agents/.codex/.cursor/.gemini scaffolding, semantic-model regeneration) sat in the working tree with unclear origin, requiring cross-session archaeology via the entire tool to establish provenance before it could be safely committed separately
open_items: docs/adr/0005 and 0006 use multi-paragraph Decision sections instead of the ADR template's one-paragraph shape — flagged by docs-cleanup-adr as a readability call, left for user's decision, not yet resolved
Step 4 (Rust client for the Lifecycle gate) of docs/type-checker-integration.md's Next step plan was explicitly stopped before, per original instructions — still pending

AGENTS.md tagline was corrected from 'drop-in replacement' to 'RDT-compatible JSON via --format rdt' by docs-cleanup-root; user was asked to give it a quick look since it changed a factual claim, not just wording, but no explicit confirmation was captured in transcript
